title: FairNet: Dynamic Fairness Correction without Performance Loss via Contrastive Conditional LoRA
reasoning: The paper focuses on algorithmic fairness and bias mitigation through a technical framework (FairNet) using metrics like Worst-Group Accuracy and Equalized Odds. While it touches upon societal bias and includes an ethics checklist required by the conference, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, theology, or specific moral/ethical systems as a core component of its research.
